title: Morning Brief, Thu 12 Nov 2026: two express trains derail about 10 hours apart on Wed 11 Nov (lead): Kolkata-Sairang Express, locomotive and five coaches at Digaru, Assam, ~06:54 (NFR; NFR said no injuries, Assam CM said four minor injuries) and Chauri Chaura Express, four coaches at Kanpur Central ~17:05 (about 300 passengers in them safe, railway officials); Delhi AQI 313 'Very Poor' on Wed under GRAP Stage III (since 6 Nov: BS-III petrol/BS-IV diesel four-wheelers restricted in Delhi and four NCR districts, non-essential construction and demolition banned, classes up to Class 5 hybrid with an online option; Noida and Ghaziabad orders 11 Nov); two SPOs missing in Kishtwar, police and Army searching; Iran awaits US reply to its seven conditions, Ghalibaf says Hormuz will 'never return' to pre-war status; Russia-Ukraine Abu Dhabi talks end without breakthrough, large prisoner exchange confirmed
